hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning, Repair and Installation in Skokie, IL
hero.sub: A backyard that puddles after every rain, a driveway drain that's stopped working or a basin that's sinking. We clean, repair and install catch basins and clear the lines they drain into. Our office is on Lincoln Avenue.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: A catch basin is a box set into the ground under a grate. Surface water from the yard, a driveway or a downspout drops in, and an outlet pipe near the top carries it away. The space below the outlet collects sand, leaves and grit so they don't plug the pipe. When that space fills, the outlet clogs and the water stays where it is.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

items.body: Brick and block basins crack and settle over the decades.
Narrow side yards and driveways funnel water toward the house.
Where water collects with nowhere to go, a new basin and drain line can fix it.
When 7.35 inches fall in five days, a blocked basin means standing water at the foundation.

blocks.body: Many Skokie backyards are flat, and water from roofs and patios collects in low corners. A catch basin with a drain line carries it away. Older basins from the 1950s were often brick, and they settle, crack and fill with silt. We clean them, rebuild worn tops and grates and check that the outlet line still drains. If yours is beyond repair, we can replace it.

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: Can you install a catch basin where my yard floods?
items.preview: Often, if there's a place to drain it.
items.answer: Often. We need a place for the water to go, like a storm line or a lower part of the lot. We'll look at the yard and tell you what's possible.

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.preview: Once a year, usually in late fall.
items.answer: At least once a year, after the leaves come down.

items.q: Can a clogged basin cause basement water?
items.answer: Yes. Water pooling by the foundation soaks in and can show up in the basement or your [sump pump](/skokie/sump-pumps) pit.

items.q: Can you repair an old brick catch basin?
items.answer: Often. We can rebuild walls and reset the frame and grate. Badly damaged basins are better replaced.

items.q: Can a catch basin connect to my sump pump discharge?
items.answer: Sometimes, depending on where it drains. We'll check the rules and the outlet.

items.q: How much does catch basin work cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the job. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it's a cleaning, repair or new installation. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
